text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Ha...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(My chest hurts... I can't catch my breath...
I just wanna collapse right here...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I have to go.
That place... belongs to me...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is
my place...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I won.
This is... my victory!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did………… itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Man, I might've had the wrong idea.
Yukino Bijin is...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She was simply giving it her all the entire time.
It had nothing to do with trends or hypes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I was always just a solitary Umamusume.
Just wanting to make my dream come true—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin! Congratulations!
I was so deeply moved...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
My heart was fired up!
I want to see you race even more...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan!
You're so cooooool!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wooww...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like my feelings
got through to 'em."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(It was worth it. Step by step,
it was worth digging deep.
All I gotta do now is keep running.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —You're so cool, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I could push past everyone
and take the top spot, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Guess things aren't that easy, huh.
You sure taught me a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep chasing after you!
Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Did you hear those cheers?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, things won't change overnight, but...
This approach ain't wrong.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've gained the confidence that I can keep
captivating everyone's hearts just like this!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—Breaking news! The incredibly,
'drop-dead gorgeous' Umamusume model,
Gold City-san has—"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"‘She has suddenly announced her entry
into the upcoming Japan Cup!’"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
City-san is...?!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
""Gold City-san, who has been focusing on her modeling career for some time now.
While there were whispers that she might retire as is—""

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"What could be the reason behind a comeback at this timing?
Here is an excerpt from the press conference."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—It's not like I ever intended to retire.
I've been keeping up with my training."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Well, I had my reasons for staying off the front lines... but the timing seemed right."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "By 'good timing', do you mean you've reached a point of psychological closure?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...Well, something like that."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "What made you choose the Japan Cup?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It was a particularly frustrating race for me.
Part of it's about getting revenge... but honestly,
I think my conditioning just peaked at the right time."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "I see. Lastly, do you have a word for the fans who have been eagerly awaiting your race, City?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"'Because if I'm not running,
I know I'll just end up hating myself even more.'"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I think so too.
*We're* running simply
to learn to love ourselves."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...I'll be waiting."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...What was that just now...?
choice_data_list: I wonder if this message was meant for someone.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that way too.
......"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I've... decided on my next target race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Please let me run in the Japan Cup.
No... I have to run in it!
In Yukino Bijin's eyes, there is no hesitation about fighting against the one she admires. Only a straightforward, heartfelt desire to run alongside her—
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san,
wait up!
And so, the next target race was decided: the Japan Cup!
